title: Speaking — Sharing news
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on sharing news.

questions: What part of your work or study do you look forward to?
When do you usually find it easiest to focus?
What would make your workplace or classroom more comfortable?
Do you expect to do something different in future?
How do you usually find out what has happened in your area?
Who do you talk to when you read interesting news?

part2.topic: Describe a piece of local news that prompted you to take action.
part2.closing: and explain why the story mattered to you.

questions: What local stories deserve more attention from national media?
How can communities reduce the spread of unverified news?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to sharing news?
